main.name: Dylan Nguyen
shortDesc: Driven full-stack developer with experience developing websites and web applications specializing in custom SAAS, full-stack development to fit client needs while delivering high-quality products on time and under budget. I focus on developing user-friendly web applications that meet the client's requirements, with attention to detail, scalability, and performance.

about.title: Dylan Nguyen
about.about: I specialize in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, Java, C++, PHP, SQL, Git, REST APIs. Additionally, I am well-versed in analytical technologies as well, such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Salesforce.com, Sendgrid, MailChimp, Zapier, as well as, e-commerce platforms like Shopify, Woocommerce, and Wordpress. What I enjoy most about software development is bridging the gap between engineering and design — combining my technical knowledge with my keen eye for design to create a beautiful product. My goal is to always build applications that are scalable and efficient under the hood while providing engaging, pixel-perfect user experiences.
